newsitem.title: UK: Highland Timber plans UK AIM float in May.
newsitem.headline: Highland Timber plans UK AIM float in May.

text.p: Forestry group Highland Timber Plc said on Tuesday it planned to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in May.
The company said it is proposing to raise up to 10.9 million stg by an offer for subscription and placing.
The proceeds from the float will be used to acquire forests in targeted areas, initially in the UK and possibly New Zealand, the company said.
The company aims to establish a quality forest portfolio which will be restocked as felling takes place.
The company said it expects to pay dividends within five years. The offer for subscrption price for ordinary shares is 120p and is expected to remain open until May 12.
